key_insight: Diffusion generation expands ABX₃ perovskite composition and ordering diversity, but does not establish enrichment near the 1.4 eV bandgap target.
engineering_relevance: Generated structures offer candidates beyond a two-prototype substitution reference, provided topology, relaxation stability and property predictions are independently checked.
method: Generate candidate ABX₃ structures with a pretrained diffusion model.
Filter for three-dimensional corner-sharing perovskite connectivity.
Assess chemistry and ALIGNN-predicted bandgaps; check six structures with first-principles calculations.
evidence_signal: The target-window fraction was 8.2% for generated structures versus 7.3% for the Materials Project reference; ALIGNN performed well on a formula-grouped random split but failed to outperform a constant baseline on a severe B-site-disjoint test.
watch_item: Different MatterGen and ALIGNN label sources limit target-enrichment claims, while relaxation can change structural classification and calculated gaps can differ appreciably from predictions.
paper_title: Diffusion-Based Generative Screening of ABX$_3$ Perovskite Compositions for Bandgap-Targeted Materials Discovery
